title: A 3D Cell Culture Model Identifies Wnt/β‐Catenin Mediated Inhibition of p53 as a Critical Step during Human Hepatocyte Regeneration

evidence_spans.quote: Here, a 3D spheroid model of PHH is established to study hepatocyte regeneration
primary human hepatocytes (PHH)
its proliferative senescence-inducing target PAI1 (SERPINE1)
integrative time-lapse multi-omics analyses

scope_reviewer.uncertainty_reason: The abstract calls PAI1 senescence-inducing but reports regeneration and proliferation without explicitly measuring, inducing, reversing, or comparing a senescent state. It also uses only a generic multi-omics label without naming currently used molecular layers.
scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This is an original human-hepatocyte regeneration study. Aging relevance and role are unresolved because senescence is only a modifier of a target, and multi-omics layers cannot be identified from the generic label.
